html:
The Non La Festival Ninh Binh takes place from April 30 to May 3, with many unique cultural activities to honor the image of traditional Vietnamese conical hats, to tourists and international friends.

Traveling Ninh Binh on the occasion of April 30 – May 1, visitors will be able to participate in many exciting cultural activities, parades and experience the art of making handmade hats. The Conical Hat Festival in Ninh Binh, Ha Nam takes place from April 30 to May 3, not only honoring the beauty of conical hats, but also being a cultural symbol to develop local tourism.

The conical hat looks simple, but it contains a profound culture, clearly showing the memories of Vietnamese people over the centuries. At the spiritual tourist destination of Hoa Lu ancient capital, the conical hat festival will open up a diverse cultural space of the ancient capital, attracting a large number of people and tourists to attend. This is also an opportunity for visitors to admire the beauty of Tam Coc – Bich Dong and admire the poetic natural scenery.

It can be said that participating in the conical hat festival, visitors not only admire the traditional beauty, but also live in the traditional flow that is both ancient and modern, bringing visitors memories of Vietnamese culture.

Visitors on a tour Ninh Binh from April 30 to May 3 will be able to participate in unique cultural and artistic events. Vietnam Conical Hat Festival is one of the most magnificent artistic activities ever in Ninh Binh.

The opening program is Hoa Lu Brocade from April 30 at Tam Coc Wharf, a large-scale ancient costume performance event, visitors will admire the splendid beauty in costumes of many dynasties of the South. This is not only a fashion show of Hoa Lu Brocade but also recreates the depth of history and the quintessence of Vietnamese culture, helping visitors have the opportunity to learn more about the culture between the modern and the past.

On May 1 and 2, the cultural and artistic space takes place at Tam Coc Wharf, the festival brings the live show Hoa Lu Vu Hoa, set in the beautiful natural landscape, recreated in the cultural space of traditional Vietnamese craft villages, through programs with dances, music, the stories of Hoa Lu Vu Hoa will bring visitors an impressive and profound musical feast, and is the pride of the people of the Ancient Capital.

In addition, the Ninh Binh conical hat festival also has many special activities that bring people and tourists an extremely romantic musical space, especially at night, the Nhuom Sac Luu Giang music scene at Tam Coc boat station.

When the sunset falls, the music stage is a place where deep and soulful melodies converge with the participation of artists such as Vu Cat Tuong, Bui Cong Nam, Phuong Phuong Thao… a special performance program between the music and the natural scenery, creating an unforgettable experience when traveling to Ninh Binh on the occasion of April 30 – May 1.

In addition to the conical hat activities, the Viet Nam Festival also brings visitors experiences of the Vietnamese countryside. On May 3, the scene of running through the village stretching from Tam Chuc (Ha Nam) to Tam Coc (Ninh Binh) is recreated. Participants will cross the fields and peaceful village roads, and visitors will be immersed in the intersection between the past and the present.

The Ninh Binh Conical Hat Festival takes place in a vibrant atmosphere, with many unique cultural events to honor the image of the conical hat and traditional Vietnamese craft villages that have been preserved and promoted to this day.
